instruction: Launch Scilab from the Applications menu. Open the SciNotes editor, create a new script with exactly two lines: "A = magic(3);" on line 1 and "disp(det(A))" on line 2. Save the script as "det_magic.sce" in the Documents folder.

verification.condition: Check if ~/Documents/det_magic.sce exists and its content contains the lines "A = magic(3);" and "disp(det(A))".
verification.expected_result: The file ~/Documents/det_magic.sce is created and includes the two specified lines.
